name: Russian Federation · coarse land outline
source: Hand-traced from the modern map at about one vertex per few hundred kilometres: the land borders with Norway, Finland, the Baltic states, Belarus, Ukraine, Georgia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Mongolia, China and North Korea, and the Arctic and Pacific coasts. Kaliningrad and the islands are left out. Longitudes run 0 to 360 so the ring does not cross the antimeridian. Used only to say whether a ground track crosses Russian territory; a crossing within a hundred kilometres of the outline is uncertain and the readout says the outline is coarse
